Enhance the beauty of your path, garden, patio, lawn, yard, walkway and planter with the distinctive water-ripple pattern of our solar pathway lights. Its enchanting touch will surely captivate anyone who sees it

【Long-Lasting and Hassle-Free】Our solar garden lights charge for 6-8 hours in direct sunlight and provide up to 10-12 hours of illumination at night. With their automatic operation and eco-friendly nature, they offer a hassle-free lighting solution that lasts all night long.

【Efficient Solar Power】Equipped with upgraded solar panels, our outdoor lights are more efficient than other solar lights on the market. This ensures that you have the desired brightness effect and lighting duration. Additionally, we have used high power LED lamp beads and a high transmittance lampshade to ensure that our solar lights are brighter than ordinary solar lights for outside

【Weather-Resistant and Durable】Unlike cheap solar pathway lights, our solar lights outdoor waterproof are made to last. No need to worry about rain, snow, or bad weather affecting the performance of our lights. They are built to last and provide reliable lighting all year round

【Easy and Quick Installation】With our simple assembly process, you can easily install the outdoor solar lights in just a few minutes. If the soil is too hard, simply moisten it or dig a small hole before installation

【Perfect Garden Gift】These beautiful solar lights for yard are not only great outdoor decorations for pathways, patios, and landscapes, but also perfect choice as a gift for family or friends at festivals, Christmas, party.
